title: How to Create Windows 10 Installation Media (Official Dell Tech Support)
description: In this video we demonstrate how to create Windows 10 installation media using a USB flash drive. asr.full_text: In this video we'll show you how to create windows installation media using a USB Flash Drive. By following these steps you will be able to install a new copy of Windows 10, perform a clean installation, or reinstall Windows 10 whenever you need to. Before starting the process there are a few things to verify pertaining to compatibility for the PC on which Windows 10 will be installed. Go into settings, click on system, then click on about. Under device specifications, look for system type. And check which processor you have, 32 bit or 64 bit. Now using the link in the description, visit the Microsoft specification and system's requirements page to be sure your PC meets the minimum requirements. Compare the sitelist with your PC specs. The video ends with these. specifications, check to see what edition of Windows you have. If you happen to have Windows 10 Enterprise, the Media Creation tool is not available for this edition. For more information on this, please visit the link in the description for the Microsoft Volume Licensing Service Centre. Now back in Settings, click on Time and Language, and then on Language, to verify which language your system is using as you will need to install the same one currently being used. If you just purchased a new device that includes Office 365, we recommend installing Office before upgrading to Windows 10. To redeem your copy of Office, the link is provided in the description. If you have Office 2010 or earlier and you wish to perform a clean install of Windows 10, you will need your Office Product key. For help with locating your product key, visit the Microsoft Office install page. This link is also in the description. Last but not least, get yourself a blank USB flash drive with at least eight gigs of space and insert it into the PC you will be using for the download of the tool. Be sure to use a blank drive because anything saved on it will be deleted. Now you're ready to download the tool and create the installation media. Go to microsoft.com and search for Download Windows 10, this link is also provided in the description. Select download tool now and then run. To be able to run the tool you will need to be an administrator for your PC. Select Accept to agree to the license terms. On the What do you want to do page, select Create installation media for another PC and then select Next. Now select the desired language, the Windows 10 edition, the proper architecture, and the media you want to use . Follow the rest of the process steps and your Windows 10 installation media will be created. Anytime you need help or have questions, you can contact us on Facebook or Twitter. Visit the Dell Community Forum and join in a chat with other Dell users. Check out our other helpful tips and tutorials on this channel and become a subscriber now. If you liked this video give it a like and thanks for watching.
